title: Models and accessors
description: The Lending records, their values and constants, and the rules that need no storage, with the store that keeps members, tools and loans and reads them back. The code is `examples/tool-library/src/model.ts` and `store.ts`.

title: Services
description:
The services that carry out the use cases: one each for members, tools and lending. Each applies the domain rules and calls the store.

```
examples/tool-library/src/
  member-service.ts
  tool-service.ts
  lending-service.ts
```

title: Router and server
description: The HTTP router that maps endpoints to the services, and the server that starts the app. The code is `examples/tool-library/src/router.ts` and `server.ts`.
